_key_extraction:
BOTH key PDFs are pure scans (16-char text layers), so unlike July-2023 and January-2024 the ANSWERS themselves had to come through OCR - the worst case. Verified four ways rather than trusted:
  1. pdftotext yields nothing; tesseract --psm 6 reads the bordered table as a field of pipe characters (63 tokens for 200 cells) and is useless.
  2. So the table was read BY GEOMETRY: detect the 12 vertical rules (4 blocks x left edge, Q.No/Ans divider, right edge) and the 26 horizontal rules, then OCR each answer cell alone whitelisted to ABCD. The question number comes from the cell's POSITION - block index x 25 + row - so a misread digit cannot shift anything. Hardcoded x-ranges silently lost 41 cells of blocks 3 and 4 before the rules were detected instead of guessed.
  3. The FINAL key page was read by eye, all 100 entries. Geometry OCR read 73 cells confidently and agreed on 70; the 3 conflicts (Q84, Q92, Q99) plus Q88 and Q98 were settled by cropping and enlarging those individual cells, and every one confirmed the eye read - the OCR was systematically misreading B as D in the right-hand block.
  4. The PROVISIONAL key page was then read by eye independently, all 100 entries, and matches the final on 100/100. Machine-to-machine comparison of the two scans also shows no difference on the 73 cells both resolve.
So: two separate documents, two independent eye reads, one geometry-based machine read, and targeted zoom on every disagreement. The key below is settled.
_final_key_revised_nothing: Unlike Oct-2025, where the final key changed Q35 and Q65 from the provisional, this sitting's final key is identical to its provisional across all 100 General Studies answers.
_letter_distribution: A 24, B 26, C 26, D 24 - a balanced spread, which is a weak but real sanity signal that no column was misaligned. (Carried forward from the half-finished gs-mes2024-source.PARTIAL.json, which this file supersedes and which was deleted once the questions were transcribed.)
_key_verified_again_2026_09_02: A THIRD independent eye read of the final key page, done after the questions were transcribed and without consulting the letters already in this file, agrees on 100 of 100. The provisional key page was also re-read and agrees on 100 of 100, confirming _final_key_revised_nothing above. Both sha256 prefixes in the fields above were re-checked against the PDFs in the mpsc-question-bank repo and both match, as does the question paper's. The key is settled: two documents, three independent eye reads, one geometry-based machine read.
_files_live_in: mpsc-question-bank repo - a DIFFERENT repo, hence this transcription
_no_filename_typo_here: This field previously carried the January paper's 'General Stadies' note, inherited by copy-paste. It is FALSE of this sitting: this paper is filed correctly as 'Jr.Grade of MES (Combined) July-2024 General Studies..pdf' and a subject-word search does find it. The 'General Stadies' misfiling belongs to gs-phe2024 only.
_paper_extraction: THE PAPER IS A PURE SCAN, so OCR was unavoidable: rendered at 400 dpi and OCR'd with --psm 6 (not psm 4, which detaches question numbers into a gutter column and would mis-align every number against its stem), then corrected against the rendered pages. Structurally verified: 100 sequential questions, each with exactly options A-D, none empty, and every key letter is one of its question's options. INDEPENDENTLY RE-READ 2026-09-02: all 8 pages were re-rendered at 170 dpi and read by eye against this file, question by question and option by option. The transcription is faithful, including the paper's own misspellings, which are preserved on purpose - 'Inter cast' (Q1), 'Environmnent' (Q11), 'Bangaluru' (Q15), 'What acids is secreted' (Q20), 'Righ of Children' (Q72), 'Tocopherpol' (Q71), 'offcences' (Q78), 'Disabilites' (Q75), '5 milimeters' (Q98) and the doubled '??' on Q45 are all what the page prints. Four defects were found and fixed in that pass: Q76 option D read 'Acchild below the age of 16 years' (surviving OCR litter - the page reads 'A child'), Q48's stem had lost the ordinal suffix from '128th Constitution Amendment Bill', and Q43 D and Q53 B had lost the spacing in 'C V Raman' and 'M K Gandhi'.
_paper_extraction_was_inherited: The text of _paper_extraction above replaces a version copied verbatim from gs-phe2024-source.json. The inherited version was demonstrably about the OTHER paper - it claimed the extraction's most important correction was Q17, 'If 7 cubed = 343, then the cube root of 343', whereas this paper's Q17 is 'India signs agreement for Lithium exploration and Mining project with'. It also asserted 'none still carrying OCR litter', which was untrue: Q76's 'Acchild' was still there. Lesson for the next staged file: a provenance note describing verification that was never performed on THIS document is worse than no note, because it stops the next reader from checking.
